'''Yaqeel Saav'etu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], and wielded an [[Color/Legends|amber]]-colored [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

==Biography==
As a child, she was safely hidden at the [[Shelter]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] base located in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], where she became good friends with [[Jysella Horn]]. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] proved to be loyal and helpful to Horn, who was having way through a hard time because her brother, [[Valin Horn]], had been recently diagnosed with a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-related [[Force psychosis|illness]] that caused him to think everyone around him were imposters. As a result he was encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. Saav'etu was part of a [[The Unit|close-knit group of friends]] consisting of [[Bazel Warv]], Valin Horn, and Jysella Horn.<ref name="Omen" />

While at a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] across from the [[New Jedi Temple]], Saav'etu and Warv witnessed Jysella Horn [[Telekinesis/Legends|tossing]] civilians across the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]]. Rushing out to stop her, the two Jedi were [[Skirmish on the Processional Way|attacked]] by Horn, who used the Force to predict their movements. After slashing Warv in the chest, Horn escaped, only to be captured by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces shortly thereafter. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cilghal]] and several other Jedi rushed onto the scene, escorting Saav'etu and helping Warv to the Temple for [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] and debriefing.<ref name="Omen" />

Sometime later, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] attempted to have Saav'etu escort [[Solo family/Legends|her family]] to the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]], but the Bothan was offworld at the time.<ref name="Omen" />

Saav'etu and Warv were wandering back to the Temple by way of [[Fellowship Plaza]] when the Bothan developed the psychosis. Warv, attempting to calm her and lead her into the Temple via the southern [[Jedi Temple/Legends|speeder entrance]], was assisted by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], Leia, and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], along with [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]. They tranquilized her, but Barv also contracted the psychosis and had to be stunned as well. The two Jedi were then hidden in the Temple as a Security force under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Atar]] arrived with a warrant to arrest them. They managed to evade being forced to hand over Warv and Saav'etu.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>

Later, a mission to evacuate Saav'etu and the other psychotic [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] from the Jedi Temple was undertaken by Han, Leia, [[Jaden Korr]], and [[Avinoam Arelis]]. They were [[Skirmish at the Krabbis Inn|attacked]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Supercommando|Supercommandos]], and with the help of Warv, managed to fight them off. Saav'etu, Warv, and the other psychotic Knights were then loaded into a [[FloatVan]] that took them safety. Soon after, Saav'etu, Warv, [[Natua Wan]], and [[Seff Hellin]] were smuggled offworld by the Solos and taken to [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] to escape the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Abyss" />

In [[44 ABY]], Saav'etu and the other Jedi suffering from the mysterious Force psychosis snapped out of their delusions in the aftermath of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Mission to the Maw|first battle]] with [[Abeloth]] on [[Abeloth's planet]]. They were brought from Shedu Maad to the Jedi Temple by [[Zekk]] and [[Tekli]]. Saav'etu participated in the [[Raid on Detention Center 81|rescue attempt]] of Jysella and Valin Horn as the leader of "Team Saav'etu." Disguised as exterminators, the team used foam coating to mask the cam bubbles of the facility and then breached the outer walls with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. Inside, the team discovered thousands of prisoners frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] alongside the Horn siblings. Despite fierce opposition from Galactic Alliance Security forces, the Horns were successfully rescued.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

On Coruscant, Saav'etu and [[Yantahar Bwua'tu]] got themselves into trouble when they were discovered by a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Suhale]], forcing Warv, Hellin, and [[Vaala Razelle]], to pretend to be [[Spice/Legends|spice]] smugglers in order to save their lives. Both the Bothan Knights were able to escape. Later, Saav'etu encountered a [[Darth Krayt|mysterious, tattooed stranger]] at [[Fellowship Plaza]]. She sensed the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] within this man and tried to apprehend him, but the stranger bested the Bothan in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. All he said to her before he left was, ''"Not yet, Jedi. [[Abeloth]] first."''<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the excerpt of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' included in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', Yaqeel's family name was given as Saavis. This was changed for ''Omen'', however, in which her last name is given as Saav'etu.
